The files are unmodified. Both hands are rigged to the fingertip: `J_Right_Hand` and `J_Left_Hand`, each with `Thumb`, `Index`, `Middle`, `Ring` and `Pinky` joints numbered 1 to 4.

The sequence break's ending uses both hands to press the game from either side until it breaks between them. They are drawn with the project's own flat, pale material, not the supplied texture, and posed in code, so these files are not edited directly.

Because the licence requires credit, the line above also appears in the Credits section of the repository's main [README](../../../../README.md#credits) and in the `README.txt` of every release download (`CREDITS` in `scripts/package_game.py`). Keep all three in step if the asset changes.
